missing_or_incompatible_behavior.repair_prompt: Install or select a compatible harness CLI before enabling write-class adapter actions.

implemented_capabilities.user_label: GitHub Copilot CLI install or marketplace setup
implemented_capabilities.note: Adapter enablement can rely on the proven Copilot CLI install and marketplace distribution path.
The adapter resolves a repo-pinned harness CLI first, then a bootstrap-managed CLI, then a user-installed CLI.
All reads and writes remain bounded by repository paths and the harness CLI/schema artifacts.
Adapter actions invoke deterministic harness CLI commands rather than reimplementing doctor, eval, trace, or repair behavior.
Reports are rendered from harness CLI JSON or Markdown output and cite the source artifact paths.
Long-running work can stay CLI-backed and budgeted while the host provides background execution affordances.
Host repair preview and approval affordances are proven. The current un-packaged scope still keeps write classes advisory-only until a runtime adapter can safely execute host-surface writes.

unavailable_capabilities.reason: Hooks are available but no public durable annotation API is proven, so annotations remain advisory text until a host API is proven.
Transcript sharing is available, but no stable item-level trace deep-link API is proven; users are redirected to CLI trace artifacts.

init.risk_boundary: Show the equivalent CLI command and require the user to run it in a trusted repository checkout.

migrate.risk_boundary: Never apply migrations through the host surface; use previewable CLI migration evidence.

repair.risk_boundary: Limited adapter repairs are prompts with equivalent commands, not host-executed file writes.

trust_boundaries.credential_handling: The adapter scope does not embed or require credentials; any future host credential access must be declared through harness credential references.
